cohort: 136 patients undergoing elective cesarean section at Shahid Motahari Teaching Hospital in Urmia, Iran
finding: Oral pregabalin taken the night before spinal anesthesia in patients undergoing elective cesarean section had a preventive effect on the severity and incidence of PDPH.
mod_finding: Oral pregabalin administered the night before scheduled cesarean section had a preventative effect on the severity and incidence of post-dural puncture headache (PDPH).
